svg.desc: Microphone level while orca-talkback speaks a four-sentence reply through MacBook speakers. The microphone hears its voice at a median of -37 dBFS; after echo cancellation the median is -67 dBFS, a median of 27 dB quieter per sample, with brief jumps at the start of each sentence.
